title: Good for quick pickup, not for deep cleaning
text: Good for quick pickup, not for deep cleaning. This little hand held vacuum does best for small jobs. Dust and small crumbs on computer keyboards or the dash on the car. It's not really designed for much more than that. For jobs that need more cleaning, I'd recommend getting the small hose attachments for a regular vacuum.
